name: Bike
description: 8 m/s on the road, 5 off it; a cargo rack of 2x8 the rider can reach from the saddle.

name: Mail Truck
description: 14 m/s on the road, 7 off it; a cargo bay of 8x10 for mail, loaded at its rear by belts and inserters. An Oil Can runs it 5 minutes.

name: Rowboat
description: Rowed at 3 m/s over the water; a locker of 2x8. Got out of onto a Pier or the shore.

name: Motor Boat
description: 9 m/s on the water; a hold of 8x10 for mail, loaded at a Small Port. An Oil Can runs it 5 minutes.
